scope_notes: V2-X is a diagnostic retest on targets already inspected in phase1; it is not fresh heldout evidence.

V2-R is first translation of four reserved synthetic scene102 paragraphs; earlier synthetic source was available during design. This is unseen-output synthetic evidence, not a new unseen authentic corpus.

system_policy_recommendations: A relation assertion must bind entity pair plus domain, e.g. classmates and credit referral; neither a single adjective nor a correct name is enough. Prevent translating network-upstream as employment-superior when the source domain says loan promotion.
Financial type inference should preserve source granularity. A small-loan label is not permission to add a consumer-credit subtype or default intent.
Use immutable narration register plus contextual peer-address rules per translation wave. Verify literary fluency independently of entity correctness and parser tree coverage.
Evaluate fresh genuinely context-dependent ellipsis and alias spans after route changes; the diagnostic improvement here is insufficient evidence for ten-thousand-chapter continuity.
Use an equal-context matched sequential versus parallel design before claiming a scheduling cause. CTRL-Y sees additional context and is only a rough diagnostic control.
adjudication_notes: Do not infer a new boss/employment fact solely from cấp trên when the same output mentions loan promotion and classmate context. Report relation ambiguity and reduced domain precision, not a proved major false relationship.
The old deliberate-default addition quỵt nợ is clearly absent; quẹt in the single control is a clumsy credit collocation, not proof of intentional default.
